hero.badge: Open source, AGPL-3.0 · self-hosted or managed
hero.title: Manage every customer camera from one place.
hero.subtitle: Keep the cameras already installed. Run the core on your own server, free and with no camera limit, or let us run it for you. Your AI and your storage plug in the same way in both.
hero.noCard: AGPL-3.0 · unlimited cameras on your own server · existing ONVIF / RTSP cameras
section.problem.title: Turn reactive CCTV maintenance into a managed service.
feature.health.title: Fleet health
feature.health.body: See offline cameras, unstable streams, low bitrate and recording gaps across every customer.
feature.remote.title: Remote access
feature.remote.body: Outbound-only gateway. No inbound ports, no per-site VPN project and no camera replacement.
feature.multi.title: Customer by customer
feature.multi.body: Customers → sites → gateways → cameras. A customer's own login sees only that customer's cameras.
feature.brand.title: Your brand, your language
feature.brand.body: Logo, product name, palette, locale files and custom CSS are runtime configuration — not forks.
how.title: From Docker command to first camera.
how.one.title: Install gateway
how.one.body: Run one container or system service inside the customer LAN.
how.two.title: Discover cameras
how.two.body: ONVIF discovery and RTSP profiles are normalized at the edge.
how.three.title: Operate remotely
how.three.body: Health, incidents, live view and recordings appear in the dashboard.
pricing.title: Open source when you want control. Managed when you want us to run it.
security.title: The customer LAN never needs an open inbound port.
security.body: The gateway only connects out. Each gateway has its own credential, a customer's login sees only its own cameras, camera passwords are kept encrypted on the gateway, and administrative actions land in a hash-chained audit log.
cta.title: Bring up the first site this week.
cta.body: One script puts the control plane, a certificate and demo cameras on a rented server. If you would rather not run a server, ask about the managed pilot.
plugins.title: AI and storage are plugins, not lock-in.
plugins.body: The Community Core and Commercial edition share one versioned plugin protocol. Keep inference close to your GPU, store video in your own S3/MinIO/B2, or connect a partner service without forking the VMS.
plugins.ai.title: Your AI
plugins.ai.body: Connect a Python/CUDA/TensorRT service or any HTTP model behind the AI adapter. Results are normalized into detections and metadata.
plugins.storage.title: Your storage
plugins.storage.body: Use S3-compatible storage via presigned transfers so video flows directly between gateway/browser and storage instead of through the control API.
plugins.open.title: Language agnostic
plugins.open.body: Plugins are isolated HTTP services. Write them in Rust, Python, Go, Node or whatever fits the workload.
plugins.same.title: Same SDK in both editions
plugins.same.body: Plugins are part of the open-source core. Commercial licensing never blocks custom AI or storage connectors.
pricing.community.title: Community Core
pricing.community.body: Run the core on your own Linux server with Docker. One script sets it up, certificate included.
pricing.community.items: Unlimited cameras|Fleet health, alerts, live view, recording|Users, customer logins, SSO, audit log|AI and storage plugin SDK|AGPL-3.0, every feature
pricing.cloud.title: Managed
pricing.cloud.body: We run your server: upgrades, backups, certificates and monitoring. Open to a few installers as a pilot; the price is agreed with each one.
pricing.cloud.items: Your own server, run by us|Upgrades, backups, TLS, monitoring|Relay for sites with no direct path|The same features and plugins|Email support
pricing.enterprise.title: Partner
pricing.enterprise.body: For integrators who sell video to their own customers under their own name.
pricing.enterprise.items: Your domain and brand, set up by us|Installation and new camera models|Reseller hierarchy (planned)|SLA and priority support
